goal: Register immutable raw-reference and invocation-stage custody without mixing source-authority SELECTs into an actual XTDB DML transaction.
procedure: Authenticate the exact canonical event and encrypted raw bytes, prepare immutable pending rows, reject an active caller writer, revalidate actual current source/context authority outside the transaction, reject a guard that leaves a transaction active, atomically issue all pending absence assertions and inserts in one native XTDB DML transaction, then revalidate immediately after commit. Deny continuation on withdrawal without deleting canonical or registered partial custody. Do not override to READ WRITE and retain a SELECT callback: XTDB does not permit query/DML mixing.
authority: Registration is private custody only; it does not confer source permission, semantic truth, model qualification or successful learned behavior.
validation: Seven targeted component regressions and thirteen existing selected-runtime tests pass. Exact transaction-mode fixture rejects SELECT/DML mixing, covers active caller transaction, rollback of both pending rows, idempotent retry, retained partial custody and postcommit withdrawal with zero downstream personality invocations. A new actual XTDB/Kurrent and signed-owner withdrawal integration case is prepared; physical CI is pending. Active caller transactions, including idempotent retries, are refused at entry before callbacks, private reads or row reads.
failure_or_lesson: A source revalidation callback inside an otherwise atomic XTDB write transaction made its first statement SELECT, causing READ ONLY inference and rejecting later ASSERT DML. Explicit READ WRITE would instead reject SELECT. Source consent and backend commit are separate boundaries; postcommit denial cannot undo an already committed private index.
notes: No user payload, trained model or accepted experiment result appears in this seed. Controlled producer outputs qualify orchestration mechanics only. This seed remains in FloRA.
